title: Tool Info hub
description: Tool Info Hub displays real-time tool damage against armored targets and precise block-mining times, dynamically scaling with enchantments and potions.
body:
# About Tool Info Hub
**Tool Info Hub** is a client-side utility mod designed to bring deep, real-time analytics to your Minecraft tooltips. Built natively for Minecraft 26.1.2 on the Fabric loader, this mod eliminates the guesswork from combat and mining by calculating your exact capabilities based on your active gameplay state.

Instead of showing generic tool attributes, Tool Info Hub bridges the gap between item data and player data to show you exactly how your gear performs in active scenarios.

## Core Features
True Damage Tracking:
 Scans the item's modern Data Components alongside your player entity to deliver a live calculation of your attack power. It handles base weapon damage, active potion effects (Strength/Weakness), and manually maps damage scaling for Sharpness, Smite, and Bane of Arthropods.

### PvP Armor Simulation:
 Displays how much final damage your normal and critical strikes will actually inflict against targets wearing full sets of Max Netherite (Prot IV), Max Diamond (Prot IV), or Standard Diamond armor.

### Fractional Mining Speeds:
 Breaks down your mining efficiency into precise seconds (s) required to break Stone, Deepslate, and Obsidian.

### Status Effect Integration:
 Dynamically updates your mining speeds on the fly when you are under the influence of status modifiers like Haste or Mining Fatigue.

### Zero Clutter:
 The advanced tooltip additions are restricted strictly to primary tools and weapons (Swords, Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels, Hoes) to keep the rest of your inventory screens clean.
